cypher: MATCH (r:DLRepository)-[:DL_CONTAINS_FILE]->(f:DLFile) WHERE r.dataset=$dataset AND r.repo=$repo AND f.path=$path WITH r,f,[line IN split(f.content,'\n') WHERE trim(line) STARTS WITH 'def ' OR trim(line) STARTS WITH 'class ' OR trim(line) STARTS WITH 'public ' OR trim(line) STARTS WITH 'function ' OR trim(line) STARTS WITH 'export '] AS declarations UNWIND CASE WHEN size(declarations)=0 THEN ['no matching declaration lines'] ELSE declarations[0..5] END AS line RETURN trim(line) AS entity,trim(line) AS fact,[r.id,f.id] AS evidence_ids
